title: Paperless Underway — synthetic offline packet workflow
description: Local Node service with durable tablet workspace and a simulated receiving replica. No government or cloud endpoint; external-link outages and EMCON holds preserve local capture.

components.label: Forms and source review
components.description: Handwritten image confirmation, supply and correspondence corrections, original source citations; synthetic formats visibly labeled.

components.label: Tasking and filing workbench
components.description: Parse constrained email/document sources, retain conflicting instructions, require explicit reviewer decisions; generate four action drafts and cited filing manifest.

components.label: Shared packet and reconciliation core
components.description: One implementation for API, UI calls and tests: validation, causal revisions, approval binding, routing gates and bounded byte planning.

components.label: Durable local workspace
components.description: IndexedDB transactions hold drafts, source media, revisions, approvals, outbox, receiver bytes, receipts and audit. Saves acknowledged only after commit.

components.label: Local application service
components.description: Foundation HTTP service hosts app and invokes shared core on /api/invoke. Local service remains present while upstream connectivity is off.

components.label: Simulated receiving inbox
components.description: Local synthetic replica performs actual byte copies and durable acknowledgements; idempotent receipts and filing. No remote delivery claim.

connections.label: Commit drafts, original media and revisions
Validated next state, audit and byte allocations
Committed offsets, receipt and filed packet
Cited verified actions and draft status updates
